citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835.
creator: Mohamed A. Rashad (Ain Shams University)
description: arabic-books is a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books using the Arabic-Nougat SOTA OCR model. It provides a valuable resource for downstream Arabic NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
name: arabic-books
rai:dataCollection: The arabic-books dataset was created by extracting Arabic text from over 8,500 books using the Arabic-Nougat SOTA OCR model, resulting in 1.1 billion Arabic tokens.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Over 8,500 Arabic books, processed through the Arabic-Nougat OCR model to extract text tokens.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may contain OCR errors from the extraction process, including hallucination and repetition artifacts from the Arabic-Nougat models used to generate it. The source books may not cover all domains of Arabic text.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset promotes the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic, contributing to broader access to Arabic literature and supporting Arabic NLP research.
rai:dataUseCases: Downstream Arabic NLP tasks, Arabic OCR research, training data generation for language models.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Arabic-Nougat (arabic-large-nougat) OCR model was used to extract text from Arabic book pages to create the dataset.

evidence.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat: The older arabic-small-nougat model occasionally generates irrelevant content, including non-existent URLs or images, due to its early training methodology and smaller training dataset. Repetition in larger models: Both arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat exhibit repetition issues, particularly in lengthy sequences.
